baseline_registry.notes: Run build, test, switch, and boot as distinct operation modes. Do not collapse their semantics.
Run single-node correctness first; measure fleet concurrency separately at 1, 5, and 10.
Record autoRollback and magicRollback settings; include post-activation connectivity confirmation.
Pin exact source SHA and journal/receipt schema.
Do not run or score until authority, persistence, and disposable-VM gates pass.
Temporary-database prototype only; do not treat it as privileged production storage.

comparison_rules: Pin identical Nixpkgs revision, flake lock, closure, VM image, kernel, systemd, cache and network conditions for matched trials.
Compare nixos-rebuild switch, test and boot as separate semantic operation modes.
Do not treat Colmena fleet concurrency as a single-host activation latency baseline.
Record deploy-rs autoRollback and magicRollback settings; do not disable normal rollback for convenience.
Only run nixward-systemd-gated after authority, store, and disposable-VM qualification; it is not an available baseline yet.
Never infer exactly-once execution from a local journal; use at-most-once submission per unresolved attempt and reconciliation.

preconditions: Disposable host is at pinned pre-state.
Approval/intent is valid but operation has no host mutation.
The same request identity is used across all retry trials.
forbidden_claims: A command exit code alone proves the intended host state.
Missing manager reply, signal, or receipt proves that no mutation occurred.
A safe hold is a successful recovery.
A queued workflow or unverified future systemd path is a passing baseline.
